posts.text: I was honored to join Foss Reservior's Rural Development check ceremony. I am grateful for USDA’s investment into rural development in Custer County, which provides critical water to communities in western Oklahoma. Farmers and ranchers are the backbone of this county, and it’s great to see the Trump Administration invest in their livelihoods not only in public health, but also enable them to maximize their economic prosperity.

I had the privilege of touring Nicrocraft's Aircraft Exhaust Systems in Oklahoma City. I was impressed by the way they approach their product designs, attempting to find innovative ways to conserve and maximize efficiency for air quality in heavy machinery. https://t.co/I8XrsLIc9T
I am grateful that the House has passed the Retirement Fairness for Charities and Educational Institutions Act. I urge the Senate to swiftly take up and pass this bill to send it to @POTUS’s desk.

My 403(b) legislation will allow our communities’ public servants, such as teachers, nurses, doctors, university professors, and employees of nonprofit organizations, to have the same financial tools available as the private sector when planning for their retirement.

I urge my https://t.co/ISWkN01VxT

Today, on Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women who have courageously served our nation to fight for and protect our freedoms. It is a debt that we can never repay. Thank you for your service! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/72wrVRhWTE

Students with computer and coding skills have a unique opportunity to show their skills to the country. The Congressional App Challenge is your chance to showcase your skills. Apply here by October 26 to enter into the competition! https://t.co/tytCNSwOxi

Are you a senior in high school interested in attending a Service Academy next fall? I want to help you achieve that dream. Seniors in OK-03 will need to fill out an application for a nomination. Deadline is October 16! https://t.co/9Iofn8Wx35

Congratulations to Oklahoma Transportation Secretary Tim Gatz on a remarkable 37-years. I am incredibly grateful for his decades of investment into Oklahoma and the way he has grown the state’s infrastructure. His impact will felt and known for several generations to come.

I am grateful that this critical and cost-effective legislation will be signed by @POTUS in the near future. 

Thank you @RepLisaMcClain, @FinancialCmte, and @RepMaxineWaters for working closely with me this Congress to get this bill across the finish line. It’s great to see the https://t.co/40CqRORfDU

I’m grateful that the House passed the AM Radio for Every Vehicle Act last week. I was proud to support this legislation, which serves OK-03 well by maintaining emergency alerts, weather updates, and other critical programming to Oklahomans when they need it most. https://t.co/xG3zvjkfPX

This morning, on the 25th anniversary of the terrorist attacks on September 11, 2001, we pause to remember the senseless act of evil and mourn the thousands of innocent lives who perished. 

We also honor the brave and courageous first responders that selflessly and without https://t.co/cepG0RFmOy

Stillwater Regional Airport is beloved by both the Stillwater community and its visitors. I was delighted to visit the airport to see and celebrate the new Regional Airport Terminal. The growth of this airport will only further enable tourism and visitors from all over the https://t.co/fAoKhD74Sm

Electricity is important to everyday life. When severe weather hits, it is important to have people you can rely on working to restore your power. OG&E reliably delivers electricity to OK-03, and I enjoyed having discussions with their staff. https://t.co/dGAadEY59x

The Senate needs to swiftly take up and pass the INVEST Act, which includes my bill, the Retirement Fairness for Charities and Educational Institutions Act. Hardworking Americans with 403(b) plans should have access to the same investments as other plans to allow them to best https://t.co/HuIG3FfhVU

I attended the Grand Opening of the Oklahoma Blood Institute in Oklahoma City. Blood donations save lives of people that are in desperate need of blood transfusions. This facility will enable donors to safely and efficiently give life-saving treatment to patients. https://t.co/mLtBWofQON

I visited the health center at the Community Health Centers of Oklahoma Highland Park. Their facility was impressive, and their hardworking staff has a direct impact on their local community. https://t.co/0x1rFFygXx

I had the privilege of meeting with the Perry Rotary Club last month. I always appreciate hearing concerns and questions from constituents. We discussed a variety of topics, including big wins in the Farm Bill along with the impacts of the Working Families Tax Cuts Act. https://t.co/DjZXG9hiRD

I wholeheartedly agree with @SenKatieBritt. Americans that use 403(b)’s for retirement should have access to the same investments as others to maximize their ability to provide for their families. Our legislation has passed the House, and I hope to see it pass the Senate in the https://t.co/GBhpdsvlIE

I appreciate Chairman Warsh’s acknowledgement that the Fed should be especially careful during benign times of any market distortions they may cause due to the size and composition of their holdings. https://t.co/NZxYopeegB

Any changes to the Fed’s balance sheet must come with clear communication from the FOMC. I welcome Chairman Warsh’s pledge to preview, explain, debate, and disclose changes to the Fed’s balance sheet with well-advanced notice given the major impact this policy has on the global https://t.co/xV1PhcJU9w

Full transparency from the Fed is critical to restore its credibility and faith to the American people. I applaud Chairman Warsh for his commitment to both periodic and end of the year updates from his new task forces to provide this accountability to the public. https://t.co/cAFDs89lwT

I am pleased to see the Common Cents Act pass the House. This fiscally responsible legislation ensures taxpayer dollars are protected while providing certainty for businesses in their cash transactions with customers. https://t.co/GhcoBj4CG3

I’m pleased to see Taiwan open a trade office in Oklahoma to expand trade investment. This will only strengthen our partnership with Taiwan, and I look forward to seeing this relationship only grow even further. https://t.co/jkoZUpC0bu
I had a great time speaking to the Gage Rotary Club! We discussed the policies coming out of Washington to help the community fight against New World Screwworm. https://t.co/vvNp9IGMgP
It was great to be back home last week speaking to the Watonga Lions Club! https://t.co/kfxEePb0aA
Happy Independence Day! Today, we celebrate 250 years of our great nation. https://t.co/jJnj8tALYT

Honored that the Financial Services Committee reauthorized the Task Force on Monetary Policy, Treasury Market Resilience, and Economic Prosperity. I thank Chairman @RepFrenchHill and Task Force Ranking Member @RepJuanVargas for their efforts towards the Task Force that have made https://t.co/xllDZ33Vie

The Beige Book is critical for the Reserve Banks across the country to show reliable, informed data to Washington for the Board of Governors that positively influences monetary policy decisions. https://t.co/H7OutSOJBR

The Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City has expertise in agriculture economics. Our farmers and ranchers need experts advocating for them in order for them to continue to put food on Americans’ tables. https://t.co/uRCBVzINTe

It was fitting for us to discuss the impact of the Federal Reserve System in the heartland of the country. Reserve Banks 
play a critical role in supervising member banks, ensuring the safety of our 
payments system, and inform monetary policy. https://t.co/fqGMbqBlfS
